_comment: Hand-curated glosses, categories and concreteness for the most frequent Korean words. These override the noisy automatic kengdic join. Keyed by dense frequency_rank from korean_words.json. Where a lemma appears at several ranks it is a distinct sense or part of speech (일 work vs 일 day-counter; 쓰다 write vs 쓰다 use), which is the point of the sense-level model.
